comment: Rough US retail price per kg of NET food content by menu category, used by build_catalog.gd when a product has no explicit price. Rounded from BLS Average Price Data / USDA ERS retail series ballparks, 2025. ESTIMATES: the point is a plausible shopping-list total, not a price oracle; players can override any product's price in game.
src: BLS Average Price Data / USDA ERS, rounded, est
